newsitem.title: USA: Frontier falls after earnings warning.
newsitem.headline: Frontier falls after earnings warning.

text.p: Shares of Frontier Corp plunged 6-1/4 to 20-1/8 after the telecommunications holding company said on Tuesday it expected fourth quarter earnings to fall below year-ago results and Wall Street estimates.
Frontier said it expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share from recurring operations in the range of $0.30 to $0.34 in the fourth quarter.
According to First Call, the consensus estimate for Frontier's fourth quarter is $0.40, compared with $0.36 the previous fourth quarter.
According to the company, long distance revenue in the fourth quarter has been affected by a disappointing response to the company's re-marketing of its "dial-around" service.
Frontier also said that the quarter will be hurt by additional selling, general, and administrative costs incurred to better position the company for future growth.
